questions.title: Do neural LMs demonstrate intelligence?
questions.question: State exactly two arguments supporting and two arguments against the claim that modern neural language models manifest true artificial intelligence.
questions.answer: 可用的支持论据：① 预训练表示可以迁移到多种 NLP 任务；② 模型能产生有用且依赖语境的语言行为。反对论据：① 流畅的 token 预测本身不能证明具有真实世界的理解；② 幻觉、偏见与推理失败仍存在。这是开放讨论题，以上严格给出两条支持和两条反对，只是参考论证，不是所附官方评分答案。
questions.questionZh: 对于“现代神经语言模型体现了真正的人工智能”这一主张，严格给出两条支持和两条反对论据。
questions.answerEn: Possible supporting arguments: (1) pretrained representations can transfer to different NLP tasks; (2) models can produce useful, context-sensitive language behavior. Possible objections: (1) fluent token prediction does not establish grounded understanding; (2) hallucinations, bias and failures of reasoning remain. This is an open discussion question: these are two example arguments on each side, not a supplied marking scheme.

questions.title: Trigram factorization
questions.question: Provide a trigram approximation for P(w₁w₂w₃w₄w₅).
questions.answer: 不使用边界符时：\[P(w_1,\ldots,w_5)\approx P(w_1)P(w_2\mid w_1)\prod_{i=3}^{5}P(w_i\mid w_{i-2},w_{i-1}).\] 假设下一词在给定前两个词后，不再依赖更早历史。注意前两项不能凭空省略。
questions.questionZh: 写出五个词联合概率的三元语言模型近似。
questions.answerEn:
Without boundary markers:
\[P(w_1,\ldots,w_5)\approx P(w_1)P(w_2\mid w_1)\prod_{i=3}^{5}P(w_i\mid w_{i-2},w_{i-1}).\]
Each later word is assumed conditionally independent of the earlier history given the preceding two words. The first two factors must be retained under this convention.

questions.title: Why a Dirichlet prior?
questions.question: Why choose a Dirichlet prior for the MAP estimate of a multinomial Naïve Bayes classifier?
questions.answer: Dirichlet 是多项分布参数的共轭先验，观察计数后，后验仍是 Dirichlet，因此可以解析地更新参数。先验相当于提供伪计数，使少见词和未见词的估计更稳定。MAP 的伪计数是 αᵥ−1；不要与后验均值的 αᵥ 混淆。
questions.questionZh: 为什么在多项式朴素贝叶斯的 MAP 估计中使用 Dirichlet 先验？
questions.answerEn: The Dirichlet distribution is conjugate to the multinomial likelihood. Updating it with observed word counts gives another Dirichlet distribution, so posterior estimation is tractable. In the MAP formula provided in the question, the prior contributes αᵥ−1 pseudo-counts. This is different from the αᵥ term in the posterior mean.

questions.title: MAP and Laplace smoothing
questions.question: Which αᵥ gives Laplace smoothing in θᵥ꜀ᴹᴬᴾ=(Nᵥ꜀+αᵥ−1)/(N꜀+Σᵥαᵥ−V)?
questions.answer: 取每个维度的 \(\alpha_v=2\)。这样分子增加 1，分母增加 \(|V|\)，得到 \(\theta_{vc}=(N_{vc}+1)/(N_c+|V|)\)。易错点：这道题给的是 MAP，而不是后验均值，因此不能回答 α=1。
questions.questionZh: 题目给定的 MAP 公式中，αᵥ 应取多少才能得到 Laplace 加一平滑？
questions.answerEn:
Set every \(\alpha_v=2\). Substituting into the supplied MAP expression adds 1 to each count and adds \(|V|\) to the denominator:
\[\theta_{vc}=\frac{N_{vc}+1}{N_c+|V|}.\]
The lecture explicitly uses the all-2 Dirichlet prior here. Answering α=1 would confuse this MAP formula with the posterior mean.

questions.title: The naïve assumption
questions.question: Why is the Naïve Bayes assumption called naïve?
questions.answer: 它假设在给定类别的条件下，词或特征彼此独立。真实语言中词序、搭配和语义依赖普遍存在，所以这种假设过于简化。它不是说词在无条件下独立。
questions.questionZh: 为什么朴素贝叶斯中的条件独立假设被称为“朴素”？
questions.answerEn: Given the class, the model assumes that input features are conditionally independent. Real words and linguistic features are often correlated, so this simplifies away important dependencies. The assumption is conditional on the class; it is not unconditional independence between words.

questions.title: Class priors
questions.question: What do the parameters π꜀ represent?
questions.answer: π꜀=P(y=c)，表示文档属于类别 c 的先验概率。常用训练集中该类别的文档数除以总文档数进行估计。不要把它与 P(word|class) 的词条件概率混淆。
questions.questionZh: 参数 π꜀ 表示什么？
questions.answerEn: π꜀=P(y=c) is the prior probability of class c. Its maximum-likelihood estimate is the proportion of training documents belonging to c. It is distinct from the class-conditional word probabilities θᵥ꜀.

questions.title: Product review sentiment
questions.question: How would you solve sentiment classification of product reviews using modern NLP?
questions.answer: 一种可行方案是在带情感标签的评论上微调预训练上下文编码器（如 BERT），添加分类头。对评论分词，在训练集上学习、验证集上调参，最后在独立测试集上评估；分类可使用交叉熵损失。这是根据所附模型与训练材料整理的可行方案，并不是唯一官方答案。
questions.questionZh: 使用现代 NLP 方法，如何完成商品评论的情感分类？
questions.answerEn: One suitable approach is to fine-tune a pretrained contextual encoder such as BERT with a sentiment-classification head on labeled reviews. Tokenize the reviews, train on a training split, tune on validation data and evaluate on held-out data. Cross-entropy is a natural classification objective. This is a proposed solution based on the supplied model and training materials, not a unique official answer.

questions.title: CKY with unit productions
questions.question: Extend CKY to handle unit productions A→B without first eliminating them.
questions.answer: 在每个单元填入词法规则或二元规则所得符号后，反复执行一元闭包：若 B 已在该单元且有 A→B，则加入 A，直到不再增加新符号。记录回溯指针，必要时处理循环；不能只扫一次，因为可能存在 A→B→C 的链。原题包含算法框架。
questions.questionZh: 扩展 CKY，使它无需预先消除 A→B 一元产生式也能解析。
questions.answerEn: After adding lexical or binary-rule results to a chart cell, compute its unary closure: whenever B is in the cell and A→B is a grammar rule, add A. Repeat until no new symbol is added. Record backpointers for parsing, and use a visited set to avoid looping on unary cycles. Applying unary rules only once is insufficient for longer chains.

questions.title: BIO classes for chunking
questions.question: For NP and VP chunking using BIO tagging, which classes are required?
questions.answer: B-NP、I-NP、B-VP、I-VP、O。B 表示一个新短语的开始，I 表示继续同类短语，O 表示不在这些短语内。
questions.questionZh: 只对名词短语 NP 和动词短语 VP 做 BIO 分块，需要哪些标签？
questions.answerEn: The five labels are B-NP, I-NP, B-VP, I-VP and O. B starts a new chunk, I continues a chunk of the same type, and O marks a token outside the selected chunk types. This is the lecture's 2n+1 construction with n=2.

questions.title: Two-channel sentence CNN
questions.question: Why use two input channels in the sentence CNN of Kim (2014)?
questions.answer: 多通道模型使用两份预训练词向量：一份保持固定，另一份通过反向传播微调，从而同时保留稳定的预训练表示和任务特定适应。原论文还说明，同一个滤波器应用于两个通道，并将对应贡献相加。当前所附神经网络课件没有完整讲解这一特定模型，因此此题依据原题点名的 Kim（2014）原论文。
questions.questionZh: Kim（2014）的句子分类 CNN 为什么使用两个词向量输入通道？
questions.answerEn: The multichannel model has two copies of the pretrained word vectors: one stays static and the other is fine-tuned by backpropagation. It therefore combines a stable pretrained representation with task-specific adaptation. Each filter is applied to both channels and the resulting contributions are added, as described in the original paper.

questions.title: Multiple feature maps
questions.question: Why use several feature maps in a convolutional layer for sentence classification?
questions.answer: 不同滤波器可以学习不同的局部模式，如情感短语或否定搭配；不同窗口宽度可捕捉不同长度的 n-gram 特征。多个特征图提供互补信息，池化后用于分类。
questions.questionZh: 句子 CNN 的卷积层为什么需要多个特征图？
questions.answerEn: Different filters extract different local patterns; varying the window width also captures patterns spanning different numbers of words. Pooling produces a feature from each filter, and the combined features are passed to the classifier. This follows the architecture in Section 2 of Kim (2014).

questions.title: Downloading GloVe versus BERT
questions.question: What do you obtain and how do you use it when downloading GloVe versus BERT?
questions.answer: GloVe 通常给出“词→固定向量”的查找表。BERT 给出分词器、网络配置和模型权重；把整个输入送入网络，才能得到依赖当前上下文的 token 表示。同一词在不同句子中的 BERT 表示可以不同。
questions.questionZh: 下载预训练 GloVe 与下载预训练 BERT，在获得的数据和使用方式上有什么区别？
questions.answerEn: A static embedding resource such as GloVe provides a word-to-vector lookup. BERT provides a pretrained network (together with its tokenizer/configuration); contextual token vectors are computed by running a particular input through that network. Thus the representation of a word can change with its surrounding sentence.

questions.title: Tag-LM contextual features
questions.question: Why use representations from a pretrained recurrent language model in Tag-LM?
questions.answer: 预训练语言模型的隐藏状态编码周围语境，可作为序列标注的额外特征，帮助区分词义并利用大量无标签文本。词向量提供词的通用表示，语言模型表示补充上下文信息。
questions.questionZh: Tag-LM 为什么把预训练递归语言模型的隐藏表示用于序列标注？
questions.answerEn: The pretrained language model's hidden states encode context and can supply additional features for sequence tagging. They complement static word representations and help distinguish uses of a word in different contexts. The supplied Tag-LM slides combine forward and backward LSTM language-model representations with a sequence-tagging network.

questions.title: Why bidirectional context?
questions.question: Why is bidirectionality desirable for sentence-level tasks?
questions.answer: 词义和标签往往同时取决于左右两侧语境。结合前文与后文，可以消解歧义，例如决定一个词的实体类型或句中含义。
questions.questionZh: 为什么句子级任务需要双向上下文？
questions.answerEn: A word's interpretation may depend on both preceding and following words. Using both directions helps disambiguate its meaning or label; left context alone may not contain the information needed by a classification or tagging task.

questions.title: Bidirectionality and leakage
questions.question: Why is bidirectionality problematic for an ordinary autoregressive RNN LM, and how does BERT address it?
questions.answer: 如果预测当前位置的词时能直接读取包含该词的双向上下文，会泄漏预测目标，任务变成“看答案”。BERT 的 MLM 对选中位置进行破坏，再用左右语境预测原 token；它使用双向编码，但目标不是普通的左到右下一词预测。
questions.questionZh: 普通 RNN 语言模型为什么存在双向性问题？BERT 如何处理？
questions.answerEn: An ordinary autoregressive objective predicts a token from earlier tokens. Allowing an unrestricted bidirectional representation to expose the token being predicted would leak the target. BERT instead trains a bidirectional encoder to recover selected original tokens from corrupted inputs using masked language modeling; it is not ordinary left-to-right next-token training.

questions.title: Bidirectional RNN-based representations
questions.question: How can RNN language models provide bidirectional contextual embeddings without target leakage?
questions.answer: 分别训练一个左到右语言模型和一个右到左语言模型，再拼接它们的隐藏表示，形成 ELMo／Tag-LM 一类双向特征。两个语言模型各自的预测目标仍遵循自己的单向条件化。
questions.questionZh: 如果仍采用 RNN 语言模型，如何获得双向上下文表示？
questions.answerEn: Train a left-to-right LM and a right-to-left LM separately, then combine their hidden representations for the downstream task. Each LM preserves its own directional prediction objective. The Tag-LM/ELMo slides use forward and backward LSTMs rather than a single next-token objective with unrestricted access to both sides.

questions.title: Scaled dot-product attention
questions.question: Why can dot-product attention perform poorly in high dimensions, and how do Transformers address this?
questions.answer: 若 q 和 k 的分量方差适中，点积的方差随维度增大，softmax 易饱和，梯度变小。Transformer 用 \[\operatorname{Attention}(Q,K,V)=\operatorname{softmax}(QK^T/\sqrt{d_k})V\] 缩放分数以缓解这个问题。
questions.questionZh: 高维情况下，点积注意力可能出现什么问题？Transformer 如何缓解？
questions.answerEn:
Large dot products can push softmax into a saturated regime with small gradients. With the paper's unit-variance assumptions, the dot-product variance grows with the key dimension, motivating division by \(\sqrt{d_k}\):
\[\operatorname{Attention}(Q,K,V)=\operatorname{softmax}(QK^T/\sqrt{d_k})V.\]

sourceEvidence.title: Attention Is All You Need, Sections 3.2 / 3.5

questions.title: Shorter Transformer inputs
questions.question: How do you handle shorter inputs in a fixed-width Transformer input batch?
questions.answer: 把较短序列用 PAD 补齐，并用 attention mask 屏蔽 padding 位置；计算损失或池化时同样忽略它们。这里的固定宽度通常指批次张量或最大上下文长度，并不是 Transformer 只能处理一种序列长度。
questions.questionZh: 批次输入宽度固定时，如何处理比该宽度短的 Transformer 输入？
questions.answerEn: Pad shorter sequences to the batch width and mask padded positions so they do not contribute as ordinary content. Ignore padding in the relevant loss or aggregation as well. The question's fixed width should be read as a batching/input-limit convention, not as a claim that attention mathematically requires every sentence to have the same length.

questions.title: Residual connections
questions.question: What motivates residual connections in a Transformer?
questions.answer: 残差连接提供较直接的信息和梯度路径，让子层只需学习相对输入的修正，改善深层网络的优化。它与归一化配合使用；不能保证彻底消除所有梯度问题。
questions.questionZh: Transformer 中使用残差连接的动机是什么？
questions.answerEn: A residual connection adds the sublayer input to its output. It provides a direct path for information and gradients and makes it easier to optimize stacked blocks by learning a residual transformation. It is used together with normalization; it is not a guarantee that all optimization difficulties disappear.

questions.title: Sinusoidal positions
questions.question: Why use trigonometric functions for positional encodings?
questions.answer: 不同频率的正弦／余弦无需学习位置查找表即可编码位置；对固定偏移，移动后的位置编码可表示为每对正弦／余弦分量的线性变换，这为学习相对位置关系提供动机。原论文也比较了可学习位置表示。当前所附课件主要展示可学习的绝对／相对位置，所以本题“为什么使用三角函数”的依据是试题点名的 Transformer 原论文，不能把现有课件当作该理由的原文。
questions.questionZh: 原始 Transformer 为什么使用正弦和余弦位置编码？
questions.answerEn: Different sinusoidal frequencies encode positions without a learned position table. For any fixed offset, the shifted encoding can be represented by a linear transformation of each sine/cosine pair, which motivated learning relative-position relationships. The original paper also reports learned embeddings as an alternative. The current supplied slides emphasize learned absolute/relative positions, so the sinusoidal rationale is traced to the paper named by the exam.

sourceEvidence.title: Attention Is All You Need, Sections 3.2 / 3.5

questions.title: Do attention heads have to differ?
questions.question: How does the model ensure different attention heads attend differently?
questions.answer: 每个头有独立学习的 Q、K、V 投影，使不同头能够在不同子空间关注不同关系。标准多头注意力没有硬约束保证各头一定不同；“能够分工”与“保证分工”需要区分。
questions.questionZh: Transformer 如何使多个注意力头以不同方式关注输入？
questions.answerEn: Each head has its own learned Q, K and V projection matrices, allowing it to represent different relations and subspaces. The outputs are concatenated and projected back. The standard architecture gives heads the capacity to specialize; it does not impose a hard constraint guaranteeing that every head will behave differently.

questions.title: Authorship verification
questions.question: Given only Alice’s known text posts, how could Bob test whether an anonymous post was written by her?
questions.answer: 可做作者验证：从已知文本学习字符 n-gram、功能词、标点和句法等风格特征，或得到文档嵌入，比较匿名文本与 Alice 文本分布。只有单一作者的样本时，宜用一类模型或距离阈值，并用留出文本校准；结论应是相似度证据，不是身份确定证明。
questions.questionZh: 只知道 Alice 的公开文章时，Bob 如何判断匿名文章是否可能由她撰写？
questions.answerEn: Treat this as authorship verification rather than ordinary supervised multiclass attribution. Build a representation of Alice's known writing using stylistic features or document embeddings, then compare the anonymous post with that reference distribution. With no examples from other authors, a one-class or similarity-based method is a possible proposal. Similarity is evidence, not proof of identity. No dedicated solution to this open application question was supplied.
questions.auditNoteEn: The supplied materials support text features and document similarity, but do not supply an authorship-verification marking scheme. This is an application proposal.
questions.auditNoteZh: 资料支持文本特征与文档相似度，但没有提供作者验证的评分答案；这里是应用方案。

questions.title: Style-preserving meaning, identity obfuscation
questions.question: How could Alice rewrite posts to preserve meaning while reducing identifying writing style?
questions.answer: 把任务建模为释义或风格迁移：生成候选改写，同时优化语义保持与风格变化，可借助回译或条件生成模型，再用语义相似度和作者识别器评估。需要检查事实、语气和细节是否丢失；风格改变不能保证匿名。
questions.questionZh: 如何把文章改写成含义相近、但较少暴露作者风格的文本？
questions.answerEn: Frame the task as paraphrasing or style transfer: generate alternative wording while preserving the message, then assess semantic preservation and the amount of stylistic change. An encoder–decoder model is one possible implementation. Rewriting can alter facts and does not guarantee anonymity. This is a proposed use of the supplied generation machinery, not a supplied task-specific reference solution.
questions.auditNoteEn: This open application is not directly answered by the provided slides; the encoder–decoder material is background, not an official solution.
questions.auditNoteZh: 所附课件没有直接回答这道开放应用题；编码器—解码器内容是背景依据，不是官方解答。

questions.title: Regular expression
questions.question: Describe the patterns matched by o+u?h|a+h+|hm+, and suggest a possible purpose.
questions.answer: 三个分支分别匹配：一个或多个 o、可选的 u、一个 h；一个或多个 a 后接一个或多个 h；一个 h 后接一个或多个 m。例如 oh、oouh、aahh、hmmm。可用于检测叹词或语气表达。未加锚点时也可能匹配更长字符串中的子串。
questions.questionZh: 解释正则表达式 o+u?h|a+h+|hm+ 的三个分支，并说明一种可能用途。
questions.answerEn: The alternatives match: (1) one or more o's, an optional u, then h; (2) one or more a's followed by one or more h's; (3) h followed by one or more m's. Examples are oh, oouh, aahh and hmmm. A plausible purpose is recognizing interjections or hesitation sounds. Without anchors, a match may also be a substring of a longer string.

questions.title: Interpreting Heaps’ law
questions.question: For |V|=kN^β, interpret β=0.99,k=1 versus β=0.71,k=80.
questions.answer: β 接近 1 表示词汇规模几乎线性增长，重复很少，可能是高度多样的词序列，例如不同姓名或标识符列表。β 约 0.7 与课件讨论的自然语言次线性增长相符。这些只是合理解释，拟合参数不能唯一确定文档类型；k 还受语料长度和分词方式影响。
questions.questionZh: 对 Heaps 定律 |V|=kN^β，解释两组参数 β=0.99,k=1 与 β=0.71,k=80 可能对应何种文档。
questions.answerEn: β≈1 means almost linear vocabulary growth: the sequence has little repetition and could be unusually diverse, for example a list of distinct names or identifiers. β≈0.7 is consistent with the sublinear growth discussed for ordinary language. These are plausible interpretations, not uniquely identifiable document types. The scale k also depends on corpus length and tokenization.

questions.title: Heaps’ law for source code
questions.question: Give a meaningful guess for β when fitting Heaps’ law to Java JDK source code, with reasoning.
questions.answer: 所附资料没有确立此题的数值标准答案。重复的关键字和语法符号会减缓词汇增长，类／方法标识符以及保留的注释又会引入新词类型，因此 β 依赖分词与语料范围。应先说明假设，再论证预期增长；这里不把缺乏依据的具体数值当成已核实答案。
questions.questionZh: 对 Java JDK 类库源码拟合 Heaps 定律时，给出 β 的合理猜测和理由。
questions.answerEn: A numerical reference answer is not established by the supplied materials. Repeated keywords and syntax can reduce vocabulary growth, whereas user-defined class/method identifiers and retained comments introduce new types. Therefore the estimate depends on tokenization and corpus scope. State those assumptions and justify the expected growth; do not treat an unsupported numerical value as a verified answer.

questions.title: Trigram conditional independence
questions.question: What conditional independence assumptions yield a trigram approximation for a four-word sequence without boundary markers?
questions.answer: \[P(w_1,w_2,w_3,w_4)\approx P(w_1)P(w_2\mid w_1)P(w_3\mid w_1,w_2)P(w_4\mid w_2,w_3).\] 关键是 \(w_4\perp w_1\mid(w_2,w_3)\)。三词之前没有更早的历史可被截断。
questions.questionZh: 无句首／句尾标记时，四词序列的三元近似具体引入什么条件独立性？
questions.answerEn:
\[P(w_1,w_2,w_3,w_4)\approx P(w_1)P(w_2\mid w_1)P(w_3\mid w_1,w_2)P(w_4\mid w_2,w_3).\]
The nontrivial truncation is \(w_4\perp w_1\mid(w_2,w_3)\). The initial factors retain all available history.

questions.title: Absolute discounting experiment
questions.question: How would the count-of-counts column look for the second half of the Church & Gale corpus split?
questions.answer: 若两半来自相同分布、大小相同，可预期第二半“出现 n 次的不同 bigram 数”这一统计曲线与第一半大致相似，但不要求逐项相等。不要把该列与“第一半出现 n 次的那批 bigram 在第二半的平均出现次数”混为一谈；后者反映折扣现象。
questions.questionZh: 在 Church–Gale 的两半语料实验中，第二半“恰好出现 n 次的 bigram 数量”这一列预计是什么样？
questions.answerEn: For equally sized halves sampled from the same underlying source, their count-of-counts distributions should be approximately similar, not exactly equal. This is different from tracking the particular bigrams that occurred n times in the first half and measuring their mean count in the second half. The latter comparison motivates discounting; it is not the second half's own count-of-counts column.

questions.title: Generative versus discriminative
questions.question: How is P(x,y|θ) decomposed for generative and discriminative classifiers?
questions.answer: 生成式：\(P(x,y\mid\theta)=P(y\mid\theta)P(x\mid y,\theta)\)，如朴素贝叶斯。判别式直接建模 \(P(y\mid x,\theta)\)；若必须写联合分布，可写成 \(P(x)P(y\mid x,\theta)\)，其中输入分布通常不是分类器学习的重点。
questions.questionZh: 生成式与判别式分类器分别怎样分解联合概率 P(x,y|θ)？
questions.answerEn: A generative classifier models \(P(x,y\mid\theta)=P(y\mid\theta)P(x\mid y,\theta)\). A discriminative classifier directly models \(P(y\mid x,\theta)\); a joint factorization may be written \(P(x)P(y\mid x,\theta)\), but modeling P(x) is not its classification objective.

questions.title: One advantage of logistic regression
questions.question: State and explain exactly one advantage of logistic regression over Naïve Bayes.
questions.answer: 逻辑回归无需朴素贝叶斯的“给定类别后各输入特征独立”假设，因此可以直接利用相关特征学习判别边界。按题目要求只给这一项并解释即可。
questions.questionZh: 只给出并解释一项逻辑回归相对朴素贝叶斯的优势。
questions.answerEn: Logistic regression does not require the Naïve Bayes conditional-independence assumption for the input features. It can learn discriminative weights for correlated features instead of multiplying their class-conditional evidence as if independent. This is the advantage explicitly contrasted on the supplied classifier-comparison slide.

questions.title: Why not Jensen–Shannon similarity?
questions.question: Give one objection to replacing a skip-gram dot product with JS divergence between t/Σᵢtᵢ and c/Σᵢcᵢ.
questions.answer: 词向量分量可以为负，分量和也可能为零，所以直接除以分量和并不能保证得到合法概率分布。JS 散度需要非负、归一化的概率分布；给出的替换在定义层面就可能不成立。
questions.questionZh: 为什么不能直接把 skip-gram 的点积替换为 t/Σt 与 c/Σc 之间的 Jensen–Shannon 散度？只给一条反对理由。
questions.answerEn: The normalized vectors in the proposal are not guaranteed to be probability distributions: learned embedding components may be negative, and their sum may even be zero. Jensen–Shannon divergence requires valid probability distributions. Merely dividing arbitrary embedding coordinates by their sum does not satisfy that requirement.

questions.title: Complete CCG categories
questions.question: Fill the three missing CCG categories in the “the girl kisses Daniel” derivation.
questions.answer: 按图中的应用、类型提升和组合规则：(*1)=NP/N，(*2)=(S\NP)/NP，(*3)=S/(S\NP)。the 与 girl 组合成 NP，再类型提升后与动词组合，最后应用 Daniel 得到 S。
questions.questionZh: 补全 “the girl kisses Daniel” 的 CCG 推导中三个缺失类别。
questions.answerEn: The missing categories are (*1)=NP/N, (*2)=(S\NP)/NP, and (*3)=S/(S\NP). First “the girl” becomes NP by forward application. Type-raise it to S/(S\NP), compose with “kisses” to obtain S/NP, and apply to “Daniel” to obtain S.

questions.title: A* agenda for CCG
questions.question: Express w,x,y,z in terms of aᵢ,bᵢ,cᵢ for the supplied A* CCG agenda.
questions.answer:
依照所附课件“内部代价＋区间外最优 supertag 代价”的规则：
\[x=a_1+b_1+c_1,\quad z=a_1+b_2+c_1,\quad y=a_2+b_1+c_1,\quad w=a_1+b_1+c_3.\]
最终句子需要 Bayern 取 NP，代价为 a₂；“Bayern beats:N” 候选需要 beats 取 N，代价为 b₂；Schalke 的另一个词法类别使用 c₃。原图把 Schalke 的跨度印成 [0,1]，与词序不符；所附课件的对应例图也有这一标签问题，但图中列出的代价支持上述解释。这是对原课件示例的符号替换推导，不冒称原卷官方评分答案。
questions.questionZh: 根据原图的 A* CCG agenda，用 aᵢ、bᵢ、cᵢ 写出 w、x、y、z。
questions.answerEn:
Using the supplied lecture's inside-cost plus best-outside-supertag heuristic:
\[x=a_1+b_1+c_1,\quad z=a_1+b_2+c_1,\quad y=a_2+b_1+c_1,\quad w=a_1+b_1+c_3.\]
The goal requires Bayern:NP (cost a₂), while the “Bayern beats:N” candidate uses beats:N (b₂). The alternative Schalke category is scored with c₃. Its printed [0,1] span label is inconsistent with its position; the corresponding lecture example has the same labeling issue, but its displayed cost confirms this interpretation.

questions.title: Verb phrase subcategorization
questions.question: Why subcategorize verb phrases, especially when training ML-based constituency parsers?
questions.answer: 不同动词允许的补语结构不同，例如不及物、及物、双宾语或带介词补语。把这些结构区分开，能让语法和统计模型捕获动词的配价及选择偏好，减少不合理解析；代价是标签更细、数据更稀疏。
questions.questionZh: 为什么要细分动词短语的次范畴框架，尤其在训练统计句法分析器时？
questions.answerEn: Verbs differ in the complements they license: intransitive, transitive, ditransitive and other frames. Distinguishing those frames lets a grammar/parser represent verb-specific structural preferences rather than licensing every complement pattern for every verb. The lecture explicitly notes that not every verb supports all subcategorization frames.

questions.title: GloVe probability ratios
questions.question: Order P(k|car)/P(k|bike) for k=guitar, engine, wheel, saddle.
questions.answer: 典型语义预期：saddle 的比值小于 1，guitar 和 wheel 的比值接近 1，engine 的比值大于 1，即 a₄ < a₁≈a₃ < a₂。这是基于词义关联的合理排序；没有给定真实语料计数时，不应把“≈”当作严格相等。
questions.questionZh: 对于 k=guitar、engine、wheel、saddle，排列 P(k|car)/P(k|bike) 的合理大小顺序。
questions.answerEn: The intended qualitative analogy is: saddle is much more associated with bike, engine with car, while guitar is not diagnostic of either and wheel is associated with both. Thus a₄ < a₁≈a₃ < a₂ is a reasonable semantic ordering. No corpus counts are provided, so the middle terms should not be asserted as exactly equal. This applies the probability-ratio motivation in the original GloVe paper.

questions.title: Why log co-occurrence?
questions.question: Why is an inner product proportional to log co-occurrence probability intuitively useful in GloVe?
questions.answer: 共现更强的词对获得更大的点积；取对数压缩极不均衡的频次范围，并让概率比转化为差值，便于线性空间表达关系。完整 GloVe 还涉及偏置、对称化和加权最小二乘；题目中的表达式是动机层面的简化。
questions.questionZh: 为什么把向量内积与共现概率的对数关联起来具有直觉意义？
questions.answerEn: Taking logarithms compresses the large range of co-occurrence probabilities and turns ratios into differences, which can be represented by linear relations between vectors. More strongly associated word pairs can then have larger inner products. The expression in the exam is a simplified motivation: the full GloVe model uses log co-occurrence counts, biases and a weighted least-squares objective.

questions.title: Static embeddings and polysemy
questions.question: How could static embeddings represent different word senses, and why is it impractical?
questions.answer: 可以给每个“词—义项”分配不同向量，但需先获得义项划分并在每次出现时消歧。标注和词义库存昂贵，未见义项难处理，且流水线错误会传播；普通静态向量则把多种词义混在一个向量里。
questions.questionZh: 不用上下文嵌入时，静态词向量怎样表示一词多义？为什么不实用？
questions.answerEn: One could assign a separate vector to each word sense. However, occurrences must then be assigned to senses, requiring a sense inventory and word-sense disambiguation. Building and maintaining that distinction is difficult, and mistakes propagate. An ordinary single static vector instead conflates multiple senses; contextual encoders address the representation problem by conditioning on the occurrence's context.

questions.title: Hadamard gates
questions.question: Why use the Hadamard product for LSTM gates rather than an inner or outer product?
questions.answer: 门的每个分量分别控制一个状态分量保留多少信息，所以需要逐元素相乘，保持向量维度不变。内积会压缩为一个标量，外积会产生矩阵，两者都不符合这种独立门控的作用。
questions.questionZh: 为什么 LSTM 门使用逐元素 Hadamard 乘积，而不是内积或外积？
questions.answerEn: A gate controls each state coordinate separately, so elementwise multiplication retains the vector shape and scales each memory component independently. An inner product produces a scalar; an outer product produces a matrix. Neither performs the coordinate-wise gating shown in the supplied LSTM update.

questions.title: Hybrid word–character translation
questions.question: Give exactly one pro and one con for hybrid word/character neural MT.
questions.answer: 优点：字符层能处理未登录词及形态变化，而词层保留较高效的常见词建模。缺点：字符序列更长且混合架构更复杂，增加计算和训练难度。
questions.questionZh: 混合词级／字符级神经机器翻译方法，各给一条支持与反对论据。
questions.answerEn: Pro: a character component can handle rare or unseen word forms and morphological variation, while word-level units keep common words compact. Con: character processing produces longer sequences and a hybrid model adds computation/architectural complexity. Give one on each side as requested. The supplied vocabulary slides support the trade-off, but no task-specific official solution is provided.

questions.title: Large-vocabulary softmax
questions.question: What is the problem with a standard word softmax when the vocabulary grows?
questions.answer: 每一步通常要对整个词表计算并归一化分数，输出层参数量及计算量随词表规模增加；固定词表也无法直接生成词表外词。可用子词、近似／分层 softmax 或复制机制等应对不同方面的问题。
questions.questionZh: 词表变得很大时，标准词级 softmax 有什么问题？
questions.answerEn: The output layer must score and normalize over a large vocabulary, increasing parameters and per-step computation. A fixed word vocabulary also cannot directly emit a word outside it. Subwords, output approximations and pointer/copy mechanisms address different parts of this problem.

questions.title: Pointers and attention
questions.question: What do pointer networks and basic attention have in common?
questions.answer: 两者都对输入或历史位置计算相关性分数并归一化为位置分布。注意力通常用该分布对表示加权求和；指针机制把分布解释为选择或复制某个位置的输出。
questions.questionZh: 指针网络与基本注意力机制有什么共同点？
questions.answerEn: Both score input/context positions and normalize those scores into a position distribution. Ordinary attention commonly uses it to form a weighted representation; a pointer model uses that distribution to choose or copy an input position as output. This common attention-based selection is shown in the supplied pointer-sentinel solution.

questions.title: Multi-head attention versus CNN
questions.question: Give one similarity and one difference between multi-head attention and a multi-filter sentence CNN.
questions.answer: 相似：多个头或滤波器能学习互补特征，再合并形成输出。差异：注意力的权重由当前输入的成对关系决定，通常可跨长距离；CNN 的卷积核参数在位置间共享，并主要处理固定局部窗口。
questions.questionZh: 多头注意力与 Kim（2014）的多滤波器 CNN，有何一项相似和一项不同？
questions.answerEn: Similarity: several heads/filters extract complementary features that are combined downstream. Difference: attention weights depend on pairwise relations in the current input and may connect distant positions; a convolutional filter applies learned shared weights to a local window. This is a comparison of the two supplied/named architectures, not a statement that they perform the same operation.

questions.title: Why BERT is not a causal generator
questions.question: Why is BERT not immediately usable as a standard generative language model?
questions.answer: BERT 的 MLM 目标让它用双向上下文恢复被破坏位置，不直接定义按左到右链式分解的下一 token 概率。标准生成不能读取尚未生成的后文，所以需要改变模型使用方式、训练目标或采用专门的迭代填充方法。
questions.questionZh: 为什么 BERT 不能直接当作标准自回归生成式语言模型？
questions.answerEn: BERT's masked-LM objective recovers selected corrupted tokens using bidirectional context. It does not directly define the left-to-right next-token conditionals used by an ordinary autoregressive generator. Generation must not rely on future tokens that have not yet been produced, so a different objective or generation procedure is needed.

questions.title: BERT encoder, GPT decoder
questions.question: Why could BERT as encoder and GPT as decoder be useful for seq2seq?
questions.answer: 编码器用双向语境理解完整源文本；解码器以因果方式逐 token 生成目标，并通过交叉注意力读取编码器表示。可利用双方的预训练知识，但必须连接维度并训练交叉注意力等新增参数，不是直接拼接权重就能工作。
questions.questionZh: 把 BERT 用作编码器、GPT 用作解码器，对 seq2seq 为什么可能有用？
questions.answerEn: A bidirectional encoder can represent the complete source text; a causal decoder generates the target from its existing prefix and attends to the source through cross-attention. This combines source understanding and autoregressive generation. Newly introduced cross-attention and any dimensional adapters must be trained; joining two pretrained checkpoints alone is not sufficient.

questions.title: Abstractive summarization
questions.question: How would you train and use the preceding BERT–GPT system for abstractive summarization?
questions.answer: 用“原文—摘要”配对数据：编码器读取原文，解码器在 teacher forcing 下以已有摘要前缀预测下一 token，最小化目标摘要的负对数似然。推理时只提供原文及起始符，逐步生成直到结束符；检查摘要的事实一致性，而不仅看词面重叠分数。
questions.questionZh: 如何训练并使用上述 BERT—GPT 系统做生成式摘要？
questions.answerEn: Train on source-document/summary pairs. Encode the document and train the decoder to predict each next gold summary token from its prefix, using teacher forcing and token-level cross-entropy. At inference, provide the document and a start token, then generate autoregressively until termination. This adapts the source–target training procedure in the supplied encoder–decoder slides to summarization; it is not an official model recipe.

questions.title: Six-word trigram model
questions.question: Give a trigram approximation of P(w₁,…,w₆).
questions.answer: \[P(w_1,\ldots,w_6)\approx P(w_1)P(w_2\mid w_1)\prod_{i=3}^{6}P(w_i\mid w_{i-2},w_{i-1}).\] 若使用开始符，可统一条件化写法；必须说明边界约定。
questions.questionZh: 写出六个词联合概率的三元语言模型近似。
questions.answerEn:
With no boundary markers:
\[P(w_1,\ldots,w_6)\approx P(w_1)P(w_2\mid w_1)\prod_{i=3}^{6}P(w_i\mid w_{i-2},w_{i-1}).\]
If start symbols are used instead, state that convention and condition the initial positions accordingly.

questions.title: Why truncate the history?
questions.question: What problem does a trigram approximation address?
questions.answer: 完整历史的可能组合数量随句长急剧增加，许多历史几乎没有观测，概率估计极不可靠。只保留两个前词，减少需要估计的条件分布，缓解数据稀疏与组合爆炸。
questions.questionZh: 用三元近似代替完整历史条件概率，解决了什么问题？
questions.answerEn: The number of possible full histories grows combinatorially, leaving very few observations for many sequences. Restricting the history reduces sparse counts and makes probability estimates more reliable. This is the reason given in the supplied Solution Suggestions.

questions.title: Unseen trigrams
questions.question: What problem remains, and give one remedy.
questions.answer: 即使只看三元组，训练中未见的三元组仍会被最大似然估计赋零概率，导致整个句子概率为零。可使用平滑，把部分概率质量分配给未见事件；例如加一平滑，或采用回退、插值和折扣方法。
questions.questionZh: 三元近似之后还存在什么问题？给出一种解决方法。
questions.answerEn: Unseen trigrams still receive zero probability under unsmoothed maximum likelihood, making a sentence containing one have probability zero. Smoothing allocates some probability mass to unseen events. The supplied solution mentions Laplace smoothing and also accepts backoff, interpolation or absolute discounting.

questions.title: BPE initialization
questions.question: For old:7, older:3, finest:9, lowest:4, initialize BPE and include counts.
questions.answer: 初始按字符分开，并在每个词末添加 </w>。加权字符计数：o=14，l=14，d=10，e=16，r=3，f=9，i=9，n=9，s=13，t=13，w=4，</w>=23。词的出现次数必须计入相邻字符对统计。
questions.questionZh: 对于 old:7、older:3、finest:9、lowest:4，给出 BPE 初始化及频数。
questions.answerEn: Split each word into characters and add one end-of-word symbol per word occurrence. Weighted symbol counts are: o=14, l=14, d=10, e=16, r=3, f=9, i=9, n=9, s=13, t=13, w=4, and </w>=23. The word frequencies, not merely the four distinct word types, determine the counts.

questions.title: Five BPE merges
questions.question: Perform five BPE merge steps for old:7, older:3, finest:9, lowest:4; stop if the selected pair has count below 2.
questions.answer: 所附建议解采用：e+s→es（13），es+t→est（13），est+</w>→est</w>（13），o+l→ol（10），ol+d→old（10）。前几步存在等频候选对，因此需要约定 tie-breaking；不同合法选择可能得到不同的中间词表。每轮应重新统计当前 token 对，不能一次性选出五个原始字符对。
questions.questionZh: 执行五轮 BPE 合并；选中的相邻对频数低于 2 时停止。
questions.answerEn: The supplied solution uses these five merges: e+s→es (13), es+t→est (13), est+</w>→est</w> (13), o+l→ol (10), and ol+d→old (10). None of these counts falls below 2. Recompute adjacent-pair counts after each merge; tied highest-frequency pairs require a tie-breaking rule, so different valid intermediate segmentations are possible.

questions.title: Interpolated HMM transitions
questions.question: Smooth trigram HMM POS transitions with weighted lower-order estimates. How are the probabilities estimated?
questions.answer: 使用 \(\lambda_3\hat P(t_i\mid t_{i-2},t_{i-1})+\lambda_2\hat P(t_i\mid t_{i-1})+\lambda_1\hat P(t_i)\)，其中权重非负且和为 1。各项由相应 n-gram 计数除以上下文计数估计，权重可用留出集确定。严格说这是线性插值，题目称为 weighted backoff。保留发射概率与结束项。
questions.questionZh: 为三元 HMM 的词性转移概率加入加权低阶估计，并说明如何估计各概率。
questions.answerEn:
Use the transition estimate
\[\lambda_3\hat P(t_i\mid t_{i-2},t_{i-1})+\lambda_2\hat P(t_i\mid t_{i-1})+\lambda_1\hat P(t_i),\]
with nonnegative weights summing to 1. Estimate each component by its n-gram count divided by its context count. For example, the trigram term is C(tᵢ₋₂,tᵢ₋₁,tᵢ)/C(tᵢ₋₂,tᵢ₋₁). Retain the emission and termination factors in the HMM objective.
questions.auditNoteEn: The sheet calls this weighted backoff; its displayed formula is a linear interpolation of all three orders.
questions.auditNoteZh: 原题称为 weighted backoff，但所附公式实际是三个阶数的线性插值。

questions.title: MEMM limitations
questions.question: Name a key disadvantage of MEMM POS tagging and an alternative architecture.
questions.answer: 所附解答重点强调从左到右的递归标注：后文可能改变前面标签的解释，因此提出 CRF 或多遍 MEMM。另一个标准结构区别是 MEMM 局部归一化，而线性链 CRF 对标签序列全局归一化，可缓解 label bias。
questions.questionZh: 给出 MEMM 词性标注的一项主要缺点，并说明替代架构。
questions.answerEn: The supplied solution emphasizes left-to-right recursive labeling: a later word can change the interpretation of an earlier label, and it proposes a CRF or a multi-pass MEMM. A standard additional distinction is that MEMMs normalize locally, while a linear-chain CRF normalizes over label sequences, addressing label bias.
questions.auditNoteEn: The original statement should not be read as saying every MEMM is forbidden from using future observed words: that depends on its features. Directional label dependencies and global normalization are different issues.
questions.auditNoteZh: 不能把原解读成“所有 MEMM 都禁止使用未来观测词”；这取决于特征设计。标签依赖方向与是否全局归一化是不同问题。
questions.sourceExcerptEn: MEMMs are unidirectional recursive computations which only function from left to right.
questions.sourceExcerptZh: MEMM 是只按从左到右方向运行的单向递归计算。

questions.title: Complete a CKY chart
questions.question: Complete cell [0,5] in the supplied CFG/CKY chart and indicate productions and child cells.
questions.answer:
共得到 S 的三条推导、VP 的三条推导及 X2 的一条推导：
S₁、VP、X2 ← Verb[0,1] NP[1,5]；
S₂、VP ← VP[0,3] PP[3,5]；
S₃、VP ← X2[0,3] PP[3,5]。
这七条回溯选择可在原题文法与配套解答图中逐项核对。S₁／S₂／S₃ 区分 S 的推导方式，不是三个不同的文法符号；VP 同样应保留三条回溯。
questions.questionZh: 补全给定 CKY 表的 [0,5] 单元，列出产生式和子单元位置。

questions.title: CCG function application
questions.question: Complete “You prefer that cake” using function application only.
questions.answer: that:(NP/N) 与 cake:N 正向应用得到 NP；prefer:((S\NP)/NP) 与该 NP 正向应用得到 S\NP；You:NP 再通过反向应用得到 S。
questions.questionZh: 只用函数应用完成 “You prefer that cake” 的 CCG 推导。
questions.answerEn: Combine that:NP/N with cake:N by forward application to obtain NP. Combine prefer:(S\NP)/NP with that NP to obtain S\NP. Finally combine You:NP with S\NP by backward application to obtain S. This matches the three applications drawn in the supplied solution.

questions.title: CCG coordination
questions.question: Complete the “We flew IcelandAir to Geneva and SwissAir to London” derivation using application, raising and composition.
questions.answer: 将两组航空公司＋目的地组合为相同的缺失谓词类别，再通过 and 协调，最后与 flew 和 We 组合。核心是对相关 NP／PP 恰当地类型提升和组合，不能仅靠普通函数应用完成共享谓词结构。完整符号推导见所附解答第 14 页。
questions.questionZh: 用函数应用、类型提升和组合，完成 “We flew IcelandAir to Geneva and SwissAir to London” 的推导。
questions.answerEn: Build the two coordinated fragments “IcelandAir to Geneva” and “SwissAir to London” with the same raised/composed category, so each can combine with the shared predicate. Coordinate those fragments, apply the result to “flew” to form a VP, and then combine with “We” to obtain S. The source's full annotated derivation is provided below; its crucial device is type raising of NP/PP arguments rather than function application alone.

questions.title: Chu–Liu/Edmonds
questions.question: Find a maximum spanning dependency tree for the supplied graph, showing intermediate edge weights.
questions.answer: 各非根节点先选最高分入边：root→Solve（11）、exam→the（8）、the→exam（9），后两条构成环。对每个节点的入边减去该节点已选入边权重；例如 Solve→exam 变成 8−9=−1，而 Solve→the 变成 6−8=−2。收缩环后选择较好的、经 exam 进入环的连接，再展开并删除冲突的环内入边。最终树为 root→Solve（11）、Solve→exam（8）、exam→the（8），原始权重和为 27。
questions.questionZh: 使用 Chu–Liu/Edmonds 算法求原图的最大生成依存树，并展示权重调整。
questions.answerEn: Choose the highest incoming edge for each non-root node: root→Solve (11), exam→the (8), the→exam (9). The last two form a cycle. Subtract each chosen incoming weight from the other edges entering that node. In particular Solve→exam becomes 8−9=−1, whereas Solve→the becomes 6−8=−2. Contract the cycle, choose the better incoming connection through exam, then expand and remove the conflicting cycle edge. The final tree is root→Solve (11), Solve→exam (8), exam→the (8), with total original score 27.

questions.title: NER as sequence labeling
questions.question: Why can sequence labeling outperform independent token classification for BIO NER?
questions.answer: 实体是连续片段，邻近标签存在结构依赖，例如 I-PER 通常应延续同类实体。序列模型可联合考虑上下文与标签转移，产生更一致的边界；独立分类忽略这些关联，更容易得到不合法或碎片化的 BIO 序列。
questions.questionZh: 为什么 BIO 命名实体识别适合序列标注，而非逐词独立分类？
questions.answerEn: Entities occupy spans, so neighboring labels provide important information about whether a token begins, continues or lies outside an entity. A sequence-labeling model can represent these dependencies and predict coherent span boundaries rather than treating every label independently. This is the motivation given by the supplied NER solution.

questions.title: Relation extraction bootstrapping
questions.question: Explain semi-supervised relation bootstrapping and how new rules are learned.
questions.answer: 从少量已知关系元组出发，在无标签语料中查找它们的上下文模式；用可信模式发现新元组，再用新元组学习新模式，迭代扩大覆盖。应设置置信度与筛选约束，避免错误相互强化造成语义漂移。
questions.questionZh: 半监督关系抽取中的 bootstrapping 如何从种子学习新规则？
questions.answerEn: Start from known seed tuples or patterns. Find their contexts in unlabeled text, induce patterns, use those patterns to discover new relation tuples, and iterate. Assign confidence to candidate patterns/tuples and filter unreliable ones to limit semantic drift. This follows the supplied solution and the relation-extraction slides.

questions.title: Evaluating open relation extraction
questions.question: What problems occur in unsupervised open relation extraction, and how can performance be estimated?
questions.answer: 所附解答指出，自我强化的抽取过程可能传播并放大错误。它建议人工标注抽取结果的样本，并比较不同输出规模下的 precision。课件也把这种“输出规模—precision”比较描述为对 recall 的间接评估。
questions.questionZh: 无监督开放关系抽取可能遇到什么问题？如何估计表现？
questions.answerEn: The supplied solution warns that self-reinforcing extraction can propagate and multiply errors. It proposes manually labeling sampled extracted relations and comparing estimated precision at different output sizes. The lecture similarly describes the size/precision comparison as an indirect recall assessment.
questions.auditNoteEn: A precision sample drawn only from extracted results does not supply the denominator for numerical recall. Direct recall estimation needs an annotated reference set or another justified estimate of all relevant relations. Keep that distinction when using the source’s informal wording.
questions.auditNoteZh: 仅从已抽取结果中抽样，只能直接估计 precision，不能给出数值 recall 的分母。直接估计 recall 需要标注参考集或对全部相关关系的合理估计；原材料的间接说法应与标准数值召回率区分。
questions.sourceExcerptEn: estimate precision by sampling the output and labelling the sample
questions.sourceExcerptZh: 对输出抽样并标注样本，估计 precision。

questions.title: Laplace-smoothed sentiment NB
questions.question: Give a Laplace-smoothed word estimate for sentiment NB, explain training data and smoothing.
questions.answer: \[P(w=v\mid c)=\frac{N_{vc}+1}{\sum_uN_{uc}+|V|}.\] 使用带类别标签的文档，分别累计各类中的词计数，并估计类别先验。平滑避免未见词使概率乘积为零。所附材料沿用 MLE 的表述；严格说，加一后的估计已不是未平滑的多项分布 MLE。
questions.questionZh: 写出加一平滑的情感朴素贝叶斯词概率估计，并说明训练数据和目的。
questions.answerEn:
For vocabulary V and class c:
\[\hat\theta_{vc}=\frac{N_{vc}+1}{\sum_u N_{uc}+|V|}.\]
Count words in class-labeled documents and estimate class priors. The conditional-independence assumption makes these class-conditional word counts sufficient for this model. Smoothing avoids zero probabilities for words unseen in a class.
questions.auditNoteEn: The mock sheet labels the smoothed estimate MLE. Strictly, it is not the unsmoothed multinomial MLE; the supplied lecture derives add-one smoothing as MAP with αᵥ=2.
questions.auditNoteZh: 模拟卷沿用 MLE 标记，但加一后的估计不是未平滑多项分布的 MLE；所附课件以 αᵥ=2 的 MAP 推导加一平滑。

questions.title: SentProp lexicon induction
questions.question: Describe SentProp and likely problems when using only a few seed words.
questions.answer: 用词嵌入建立近邻图，从正面与负面种子进行随机游走／标签传播，再比较并归一化传播得分以产生词的情感极性。种子偏差、图的连通性、领域差异和反义词语境相似都可能影响结果；应对种子与领域进行评估。
questions.questionZh: 描述 SentProp 情感词典归纳算法，并说明少量种子可能带来的问题。
questions.answerEn: Construct a nearest-neighbor graph over word embeddings, select positive and negative seed words, and propagate their polarities by random walks. A word's raw positive/negative scores reflect visits from the corresponding seeds; normalize the scores. Too few or poorly spread seeds leave low-confidence regions, and opposite-polarity words can be close in embedding space. Repeating with varied seeds gives a variability/confidence estimate in the lecture.

questions.title: TF–IDF
questions.question: Define tf, idf and their combination in a TF–IDF matrix.
questions.answer: 一种常见约定：\(tf_{t,d}=count(t,d)\)，\(idf_t=\log(N/df_t)\)，\(w_{t,d}=tf_{t,d}\cdot idf_t\)。N 是文档总数，df 是包含该词的文档数。对数底数、TF 缩放与 IDF 平滑有不同约定，计算时要说明。
questions.questionZh: 给出词频 tf、逆文档频率 idf 及 TF–IDF 矩阵元素的公式。
questions.answerEn:
The supplied solution uses
\[tf_{t,d}=count(t,d),\quad idf_t=\log_{10}(N/df_t),\quad w_{t,d}=tf_{t,d}\,idf_t.\]
N is the number of documents and dfₜ counts documents containing t. Other TF scalings or IDF smoothings exist, but these are the conventions printed in this solution.

questions.title: Sparse representations
questions.question: State two problems with sparse word representations.
questions.answer: ① 维度随词表变大，存储与运算可能昂贵。② 词面不同但语义相近的词通常缺少直接相似性，泛化及语义比较能力有限。稀疏矩阵本身也可以高效存储，因此不要简单声称所有稀疏表示都必须占满高维空间。
questions.questionZh: 稀疏词表示有哪些问题？列出两项。
questions.answerEn: (1) Vocabulary-sized representations have high dimensionality and can make modeling/processing expensive. (2) Distinct coordinates do not directly capture semantic similarity between different but related words. The lecture contrasts these problems with dense lower-dimensional embeddings. Sparse storage can reduce memory use; high dimensionality does not mean every zero must be stored.

questions.title: Distributional hypothesis
questions.question: What hypothesis motivates learning word representations from context?
questions.answer: 分布式假设：出现在相似上下文中的词，通常具有相关含义。通过共现或上下文预测学习语义表示；上下文嵌入进一步让每次词的出现随具体语境改变。注意“语义相关”并不必然等于同义，反义词也可能共享语境。
questions.questionZh: 用上下文学习词表示，依赖的核心假设是什么？
questions.answerEn: The distributional hypothesis: words occurring in similar contexts tend to have similar meanings. Representing a word through its contextual distribution therefore provides semantic information. Contextual embeddings additionally allow the representation of a particular occurrence to depend on that occurrence's context.

questions.title: Negative sampling
questions.question: What is negative sampling in skip-gram, and why use it?
questions.answer: 对每个真实中心词—上下文词对，抽取少量噪声词对，训练二元分类目标以区分真实与噪声。这样每次只更新少量词向量，避免完整词表 softmax 的昂贵归一化。负采样是替代训练目标，不能不加说明地当作完整 softmax 的精确概率。
questions.questionZh: skip-gram 中的负采样是什么？为什么采用它？
questions.answerEn: For an observed word–context pair, sample a small number of noise pairs and train a binary distinction between observed and sampled pairs. Only a few embeddings need to be updated per training case, avoiding the full-vocabulary normalization cost of the original softmax objective. The supplied slides formulate this as a logistic classification objective; it is a replacement training objective, not an exact full-softmax probability computation.

questions.title: Noise distribution
questions.question: Suggest a negative-sampling distribution that reduces the dominance of frequent words.
questions.answer: 常用 \(P_n(w)=f(w)^{3/4}/\sum_u f(u)^{3/4}\)。小于 1 的指数使分布比原始词频更平坦，降低高频词相对于低频词的优势，但仍给高频词较大概率。这不是“与词频负相关”；不要照搬所附建议解中不够准确的措辞。
questions.questionZh: 如何选择负采样分布，使常见词不至于过度主导样本？
questions.answerEn:
Use a flattened frequency distribution, as in the supplied skip-gram slides:
\[P_n(w)=\frac{f(w)^{0.75}}{\sum_u f(u)^{0.75}}.\]
Compared with sampling directly from f(w), the fractional exponent increases rare words' relative share and reduces the dominance of frequent words. It does not make frequent words less likely than rare words.
questions.auditNoteEn: The mock solution says “negatively proportional” but then suggests a fractional power. Those are not equivalent: f(w)^0.75 is increasing in f(w). The formula and relative-flattening explanation above follow the lecture.
questions.auditNoteZh: 模拟解答写了 negatively proportional，又建议使用分数幂，两者并不等价：f(w)^0.75 仍随词频增加。这里的公式及“相对变平”解释以所附课件为准。
questions.sourceExcerptEn: negatively proportional to their overall occurrence in the corpus such as raising word counts to a fractional power
questions.sourceExcerptZh: 与在语料中的总出现次数呈负比例，例如把词频取分数次幂。

questions.title: Ranking hinge loss
questions.question: Define a ranking hinge loss with margin.
questions.answer: \[L=\max(0,m-s(x^+)+s(x^-)).\] m>0 是间隔，正确候选得分至少比错误候选高 m 时损失为零。若模型输出的是距离而不是相似度，符号方向需要相应调整。
questions.questionZh: 写出带间隔的排序 hinge loss。
questions.answerEn:
For a positive candidate x⁺, a negative candidate x⁻ and margin m>0:
\[L=\max\{0,m-s(x^+)+s(x^-)\}.\]
The loss is zero once the positive score exceeds the negative score by at least m. The supplied solution uses unit margin. If scores are distances rather than similarities, reverse the corresponding ordering.

questions.title: Where to use ranking loss
questions.question: Give one NLP application for ranking hinge loss and explain why.
questions.answer: 所附解答给出的例子是神经信息抽取：希望正确关系元组得分高于错误元组。排序损失直接鼓励这种相对顺序，而不要求对每个候选分别得到校准的类别概率。信息检索排序也是相容的例子，但按题意说明一个即可。
questions.questionZh: 举一个适合排序 hinge loss 的 NLP 任务，并说明原因。
questions.answerEn: The supplied solution gives neural information extraction: score correct relation tuples above incorrect ones. The objective directly encourages the desired ordering rather than requiring an independently calibrated class probability for every candidate. Information retrieval ranking is another compatible example, but one explained example is enough.

questions.title: Pooling in NLP CNNs
questions.question: Explain pooling and give an application where dynamic pooling is helpful.
questions.answer: 池化把一组局部特征聚合为更紧凑的表示，例如最大池化保留区域内最强的激活。所附解答举的是科研论文分类：对 related work、methods、results 等不同作用的章节分别池化。不要把所有池化都等同于最大池化；这里仅按原解所举例子说明。
questions.questionZh: 解释 NLP CNN 中的池化，并举动态分区池化适用的任务。
questions.answerEn: Pooling aggregates a collection of local features into a more compact representation; max pooling retains the strongest activation in a region. The supplied solution suggests scientific-paper classification, pooling separately over sections such as related work, methods and results because these regions have different roles. Do not identify every pooling operation with max pooling: that is the example used here.

questions.title: LSTM memory and forget gate
questions.question: How does LSTM improve on a vanilla RNN, and what does the forget gate do?
questions.answer: LSTM 用细胞状态及门控提供较稳定的信息路径，缓解长程依赖的学习困难。\(c_t=f_t\odot c_{t-1}+i_t\odot\tilde c_t\)：遗忘门 f 逐维控制旧记忆保留比例，输入门控制新记忆写入。它缓解而非彻底解决梯度消失。
questions.questionZh: LSTM 相对普通 RNN 的主要改进是什么？遗忘门怎样发挥作用？
questions.answerEn:
LSTMs use a separate cell state and gates to regulate memory flow, helping with vanishing gradients and long-range dependencies. The update is
\[c_t=f_t\odot c_{t-1}+i_t\odot\tilde c_t.\]
The forget gate fₜ scales how much old memory is retained; the input gate controls the new contribution. Forgetting reduces old-state components rather than literally overwriting every component with new input.

questions.title: RNN versus fixed-window LM
questions.question: Give two advantages of an RNN LM over a fixed-window neural LM.
questions.answer: ① 用递归状态处理可变长度历史，而不局限于固定窗口。② 时间步间共享参数，延长输入不需要增加对应位置的新参数。实践中远距离信息仍可能因梯度或状态容量限制而丢失。
questions.questionZh: RNN 语言模型相对固定窗口神经模型，有哪两项优势？
questions.answerEn: It can condition on a variable-length history rather than a fixed-size input window, and it shares the same recurrent parameters across time steps, so increasing sequence length does not require new position-specific parameters. Practical memory of distant history is still limited by training and state capacity.

questions.title: The seq2seq bottleneck
questions.question: What is the bottleneck in the supplied RNN encoder–decoder diagram?
questions.answer: 把整个源句压缩进单个固定长度状态，可能丢失细节，长句和长距离依赖尤其困难。解码器若只能访问这个表示，不能在各步灵活检索源句不同位置的信息。
questions.questionZh: 原图中的 RNN encoder–decoder 存在什么信息瓶颈？
questions.answerEn: The decoder receives source information through a single final encoder state, which must summarize the entire input. This fixed-size bottleneck can lose details, particularly for long sequences, and the final state can favor more recent inputs. The supplied solution identifies this as the bottleneck problem.

questions.title: Attention as a remedy
questions.question: How can attention alleviate the bottleneck? Give equations and explain normalization. Original sheet labels this item (1.2).
questions.answer: 令 \(e_{ti}=score(s_t,h_i)\)，\(\alpha_{ti}=\operatorname{softmax}_i(e_{ti})\)，\(c_t=\sum_i\alpha_{ti}h_i\)。每个解码步根据当前状态访问所有编码器状态。softmax 把分数转为非负、和为 1 的权重，并突出相对重要位置；不是硬性只保留最高项。
questions.questionZh: 如何用注意力缓解上述瓶颈？写出公式并解释归一化作用。（原卷误标为 1.2。）
questions.answerEn:
For decoder state sₜ and encoder states hᵢ, compute scores and a context:
\[e_{ti}=s_t^Th_i,\quad\alpha_{ti}=\operatorname{softmax}_i(e_{ti}),\quad c_t=\sum_i\alpha_{ti}h_i.\]
The decoder can use a different weighted combination of all encoder states at each step. Softmax turns scores into nonnegative weights summing to 1 and emphasizes relatively relevant states. It is a soft weighting, not a hard selection of only the highest-scoring state.

questions.title: Pointer–sentinel mixture
questions.question: Why mix a standard softmax RNN with a pointer network?
questions.answer: softmax 擅长生成词表内的一般词，指针机制可以从近期上下文复制低频词、实体名等。混合模型兼顾基于词汇表的泛化与上下文中的精确复制，缓解稀有词和大词表问题。
questions.referenceTitle: Pointer Sentinel Mixture Models · 原论文
questions.questionZh: 为什么将词表 softmax RNN 与指针模型混合用于语言建模？
questions.answerEn: The softmax branch can generate a vocabulary word even when it is not in the recent context. The pointer branch can reproduce rare or out-of-vocabulary words that do occur in the input/context, but cannot copy an absent word. Mixing the two uses contextual copying when appropriate and backs off to vocabulary prediction otherwise. This is the distinction explicitly made on the supplied solution page.

questions.title: The sentinel gate
questions.question: What is the mixture gate, and how is it determined?
questions.answer:
在指针注意力分数 z 后添加 sentinel 分数 qᵀs，其中 s 为可学习向量，再统一 softmax：
\[a=\operatorname{softmax}([z;q^Ts]),\qquad g=a_{L+1}.\]
sentinel 所获得的概率质量 g 是词表分支的混合门；其余项对应上下文位置。g 小时偏向复制，g 大时偏向词表 softmax。所附解答强调，让指针机制自己决定何时退回词表预测。这里用 L 表示上下文位置数，避免与词表大小 V 混淆。
questions.referenceTitle: Pointer Sentinel Mixture Models · 原论文
questions.questionZh: Pointer Sentinel 模型中的混合门如何决定？
questions.answerEn:
Extend the pointer attention logits z by the sentinel score qᵀs, where s is learned. After one softmax, the mass on the sentinel is the vocabulary gate:
\[a=\operatorname{softmax}([z;q^Ts]),\qquad g=a_{L+1}.\]
The other entries allocate mass to context positions. A small g favors copying; a large g favors the vocabulary softmax. The supplied solution motivates this as letting the pointer mechanism itself decide when to defer.
questions.auditNoteEn: The source explains peaky versus flat pointer scores as intuition. A flat z alone does not mathematically guarantee a large gate: qᵀs is also involved.
questions.auditNoteZh: 原解把尖峰／平坦分数作为直觉说明；仅凭 z 平坦并不能数学保证 g 大，还取决于 qᵀs。

questions.title: Why multiple attention heads?
questions.question: What do multiple heads achieve, and what limitation can a single head have?
questions.answer: 不同投影让多个头可以同时表示不同位置关系和子空间特征。单头只有一套注意力分布，可能把需要区分的关系混合。多头提供能力上的余地，但并不保证每个头都会学到有用且不同的功能。
questions.questionZh: 多头注意力的作用是什么？单个头可能有什么局限？
questions.answerEn: Multiple learned projections allow several attention patterns/subspaces to be represented in parallel and then combined. A single head has only one attention distribution per query at that layer and can have difficulty representing different simultaneous relations. This is the motivation in the supplied solution and lecture; specialization is possible, not guaranteed for every head.

questions.title: Decoder masking
questions.question: What is the decoder’s role, and why use masked attention?
questions.answer: 解码器根据已有目标前缀生成后续 token，并通过交叉注意力读取源句表示。因果 mask 阻止当前位置读取未来目标词，防止训练时泄漏答案，并使训练的条件化与自回归推理一致。
questions.questionZh: Transformer 解码器做什么？为什么需要因果掩码？
questions.answerEn: The decoder generates target tokens from their existing prefix and uses cross-attention to the encoder output. A causal mask prevents a target position from attending to future target tokens, avoiding answer leakage during training and matching autoregressive inference. Keep masked self-attention separate from encoder–decoder cross-attention.

questions.title: Pretraining versus SFT
questions.question: How do pretraining and supervised instruction fine-tuning differ?
questions.answer: 预训练通常从大规模文本学习 token 预测；SFT 使用指令—回答等示例，使模型遵循任务格式与用户意图。二者的数据、目标应用和训练阶段不同。
questions.questionZh: 预训练与有监督指令微调 SFT 有何区别？
questions.answerEn: Pretraining learns a language-model objective from large-scale text. Supervised instruction tuning uses instruction–response examples to adapt that model toward task-following behavior. The supplied post-training slides contrast pretraining with instruction-tuning data and application-specific supervision.

questions.title: RLHF versus DPO
questions.question: Compare reward-model/PPO alignment with DPO.
questions.answer: 典型 RLHF 流程先从偏好训练奖励模型，再用 PPO 等方法优化策略并约束偏离参考模型。DPO 利用偏好对直接优化策略的对数概率比，省去显式奖励模型及在线强化学习循环；仍依赖偏好数据和参考策略。
questions.questionZh: 比较奖励模型＋PPO 对齐与 DPO。
questions.answerEn: The supplied RL-PPO route learns a reward model from preference data and then optimizes a language-model policy while controlling deviation from a reference model. DPO uses a direct preference objective on chosen/rejected response pairs rather than a separate explicit reward-model/PPO optimization loop. Both still depend on the quality of the preference data.

questions.title: Why KL regularization?
questions.question: Why constrain the aligned model to remain close to a reference model?
questions.answer: 仅最大化一个并不完美的奖励模型，可能利用其漏洞并偏离原有语言能力。KL 一类约束限制策略漂移，在提高偏好得分与保留预训练行为之间取得平衡。
questions.questionZh: 对齐训练为什么要约束模型接近参考策略？
questions.answerEn: Optimizing only the preference reward can push the policy too far from the pretrained/reference model. A closeness constraint, commonly expressed through KL regularization, balances reward improvement against policy drift and loss of pretrained behavior. The supplied slide motivates this by catastrophic forgetting and staying close to the pretrained LM.

questions.title: Test-time compute
questions.question: What test-time prompting approaches are explicitly covered in the supplied slides, and what are their limits?
questions.answer: 所附课件明确列出 few-shot prompting 与 chain-of-thought prompting：通过示例或中间推理引导回答。效果依赖任务和模型，更长的推理本身并不是答案正确的证据。原课件没有确立任何特定验证器／搜索方法都必然提高结果的结论。
questions.questionZh: 课件给出的 test-time compute／推理时方法有哪些？有什么局限？
questions.answerEn: The supplied slides explicitly introduce few-shot prompting and chain-of-thought prompting as test-time approaches: use demonstrations or intermediate reasoning in the prompt/output to guide the answer. Their effectiveness depends on the task and model; more generated reasoning is not itself evidence of correctness. The provided slides do not establish that any particular verification/search scheme will always improve results.

questions.title: A minimal RAG pipeline
questions.question: Describe a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline.
questions.answer: 离线切分并索引文档；在线根据问题检索相关片段，可重排，再把问题和证据提供给生成器。输出应与证据对应。检索缺失、过时文档、无关上下文和错误归因仍可能导致错误。
questions.questionZh: 描述一个基本的检索增强生成 RAG 流程。
questions.answerEn: Retrieve relevant passages for a question and condition the generator on those passages together with the question. An implementation typically indexes documents first, optionally reranks retrieved results, and then constructs the generation context. The supplied slides also discuss multi-hop retrieval and limits such as retrieval scope and data quality.

questions.title: BM25 versus dense retrieval
questions.question: Compare lexical BM25 retrieval and dense embedding retrieval.
questions.answer: BM25 依赖词项匹配、词频饱和及长度归一化，擅长精确术语；稠密检索用学习到的向量相似度捕捉语义相关性，可能更适合释义。两者有互补性，可用混合检索；不能说任何一方普遍更优。
questions.questionZh: 比较 BM25 词项检索与稠密向量检索。
questions.answerEn: BM25 uses lexical matches with term-frequency saturation and document-length normalization. Dense retrieval compares learned query/document representations and can mitigate vocabulary mismatch. The supplied slides describe both lexical matching and dense-vector alternatives. Their strengths are complementary; neither is established as universally better.

questions.title: Precision@k and recall@k
questions.question: Define precision@k and recall@k.
questions.answer: \(P@k=\#\text{前k项中相关项}/k\)。\(R@k=\#\text{前k项中相关项}/\#\text{全部相关项}\)。召回率需要已知或估计相关项总数；k 和评估集合必须一致。
questions.questionZh: 定义 Precision@k 与 Recall@k。
questions.answerEn:
\[P@k=\frac{\#\text{ relevant results in top }k}{k},\qquad R@k=\frac{\#\text{ relevant results in top }k}{\#\text{ all relevant results}}.\]
Recall requires a reference or justified estimate for the total number of relevant items. Keep the collection and the cutoff k fixed when comparing systems.

questions.title: RAG evaluation
questions.question: How would you evaluate retrieval and answer generation separately?
questions.answer: 检索环节用相关性标注与按排名计算的 precision／recall 等指标评估；生成环节另行检查是否正确使用已检索证据、是否忠实于其内容。区分“没有检到需要的片段”和“片段已存在但没有正确使用”。这是根据所附 IR 指标和 RAG 局限整理的评估设计，不是历年试卷解答。
questions.questionZh: 如何分开评估 RAG 的检索环节和生成环节？
questions.answerEn: Evaluate retrieval with relevance judgments and ranked-retrieval measures such as precision/recall at a cutoff. Separately evaluate whether the generated answer correctly uses the retrieved evidence and preserves its content. Distinguish failing to retrieve the needed passage from failing to use an available passage. This is an evaluation design derived from the supplied IR metrics and RAG limitations, not a past-exam solution.

questions.title: Semantic role labeling
questions.question: How does semantic role labeling differ from syntactic dependency parsing?
questions.answer: 依存分析描述句法关系，如主语或宾语；语义角色标注围绕谓词描述“谁对谁做了什么、何时何地”等角色。同一语义角色可随主动／被动句对应不同句法位置。
questions.questionZh: 语义角色标注与句法依存分析有什么区别？
questions.answerEn: Dependency parsing describes syntactic relations, whereas semantic role labeling assigns roles to a predicate's participants, such as Agent and Theme. Those roles can generalize across different surface realizations, including changes in grammatical subject/object positions. The supplied SRL slides explicitly connect semantic properties with syntactic realization and discuss diathesis alternations.

questions.title: Coreference
questions.question: Why is coreference resolution more than finding identical strings?
questions.answer: 不同表达可指同一实体，如姓名、描述和代词；相同字符串也可指不同实体。需要利用上下文、语法约束、语义兼容性及篇章信息，避免把仅相关但不同的实体误合并。
questions.questionZh: 为什么共指消解不能只匹配相同字符串？
questions.answerEn: Coreference resolution finds mentions referring to the same real-world entity. A name, a description and a pronoun may corefer despite different wording; identical names can also refer to different entities. Context, agreement and semantic compatibility are needed to decide which mentions belong to the same cluster.

questions.title: Discourse coherence
questions.question: What is the difference between local lexical overlap and discourse coherence?
questions.answer: 词汇重复可以提供连接线索，但篇章连贯还依赖实体延续、时间／因果关系、话语关系和整体目标。词重叠高的句子也可能逻辑矛盾；重叠低的句子仍可构成清晰的因果叙述。
questions.questionZh: 词汇重复与篇章连贯有什么区别？
questions.answerEn: Lexical overlap is only one possible cue. The supplied discourse slides also discuss coherence relations such as reason/elaboration and continuity of salient entities. Repetition alone does not establish a coherent discourse, and sentences can be connected by meaningful discourse relations without repeating the same words.

questions.title: Masked versus causal objectives
questions.question: Contrast masked language modeling with causal language modeling.
questions.answer: MLM 从被破坏输入的双向语境恢复选中 token；因果 LM 只根据过去预测下一 token。前者适合理解型表示，后者直接支持自回归生成；应用并不局限于这两个标签，关键在训练目标和注意力可见性。
questions.questionZh: 对比 masked language modeling 与 causal language modeling。
questions.answerEn: A masked LM recovers selected original tokens from corrupted input using bidirectional context. A causal LM predicts the next token from its preceding context, supporting left-to-right autoregressive generation. The relevant distinction is the training objective and attention visibility, not a universal restriction of all downstream applications.

questions.title: Benchmark contamination
questions.question: Why can training/test contamination make an LLM benchmark misleading?
questions.answer: 若测试问题或答案进入训练集，模型可能记忆而非泛化，分数会高估面对真正新问题时的能力。应审查数据来源、去重，使用隔离或更新的评估集，并报告已知污染风险。
questions.questionZh: 为什么训练／测试数据污染会使大模型评测产生误导？
questions.answerEn: A benchmark must test data independent of training. If benchmark questions or answers entered pretraining, a high score may reflect exposure or memorization rather than generalization to new cases. The lecture explicitly warns about pretraining contamination and emphasizes knowing the training data. Data separation and deduplication are appropriate evaluation checks.

questions.title: Translation evaluation
questions.question: Why is a high n-gram overlap score insufficient to establish translation quality?
questions.answer: 同一含义可有多种译法，词面重叠可能惩罚正确释义；反过来，重叠很高也可能存在否定、数字或实体错误。应结合语义质量、事实忠实性和适当人工评估。
questions.questionZh: 为什么较高的 n-gram 重叠分数不足以证明翻译质量高？
questions.answerEn: Surface overlap does not fully measure meaning: correct paraphrases can use different words, while an output with many matching words can still mishandle a crucial fact or negation. The supplied slides list limitations of overlap metrics, including lack of synonym awareness. Use additional semantic/adequacy assessment and suitable human judgment when needed.
